## Install

1. Download **NotesFloat-*.dmg** below, open it, and drag **NotesFloat** to **Applications**.
2. Open it. This build isn't notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks the first launch: go to
   **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to NotesFloat.
   (Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/NotesFloat.app"` in Terminal.)
3. The welcome guide walks you through access to Apple Notes and the optional Full Disk Access.

**Already using NotesFloat 0.3 or later?** It updates itself; you don't need to download anything.
Earlier versions don't include the updater, so install this one manually once.

Requires macOS 26 or later (Apple silicon or Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
More at [alhassan.raoufs.me/work/NotesFloat](https://alhassan.raoufs.me/work/NotesFloat).
